PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, AUGUST 7, 2025
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARDROOM, 9:00 AM

Gina Maguire, President  Charles Parkin, Commissioner
Kevin Scott, Vice President  Naomi Rainey, Commissioner
Gloria Cordero, Secretary

B. Anatole Falagán, General Manager  Marsha Yasuda, Deputy City Attorney

 MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT EMAIL WRITTEN COMMENTS TO
  COMMISSION@LBUTILITIES.ORG

 CALL TO ORDER

 PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

 ROLL CALL

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  25-56051  Recommendation to approve July 24, 2025 Board meeting minutes.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 2.  25-56052  Recommendation to receive and file the update on Sewer Operations &
  Maintenance and Capital Improvement Program (CIP) related to the 2028
  Olympics.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 3.  25-56053  Recommendation to adopt Request for Proposal for the S-9 Sewer Lift Station
  Rehabilitation Project (SC-0499), award a contract to GHD, Inc., in the amount not
  to exceed $506,946 for a period of one year and authorize the General Manager to
  execute all documents necessary to enter into the contract, including any
  necessary subsequent amendments.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 4.  25-56054  Recommendation to adopt Request for Proposal for the Cherry Avenue Sewer
  Improvement Project (SC-0512), award a contract to DRP Engineering, Inc., in the
  amount not to exceed $276,800 for a period of one year, and authorize the
  General Manager to execute all documents necessary to enter into the contract,
  including any necessary subsequent amendments.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 5.  25-56055  Recommendation to relieve the bid submitted by Mike Prlich and Sons, Inc. as
  described in their letter dated July 14, 2025, requesting withdrawal of their bid due

  to clerical errors; and adopt Specifications WD-17-24 for the Alamitos 9A & 14
  Pump-to-Waste Drain Line Project (EO-3715), award a contract to Giles
  Engineering, in a total contract amount not to exceed $867,556.55 for a period of
  one year, and authorize the General Manager to execute all documents necessary
  to enter into the contract, including any necessary subsequent amendments.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  25-56056  Recommendation to adopt Request for Proposals UD-24-210 for Cathodic
  Protection Deep Well Abandonment, award a contract to Accurate Corrosion
  Control Inc., an Arizona corporation, in a total contract amount not to exceed
  $240,000, and authorize the General Manager to execute all documents necessary
  to enter into the contract, including any necessary subsequent amendments.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  25-56057  Recommendation to authorize the General Manager to execute Amendments to
  Agreement Nos. UT-3825, UT-3826, and UT-3827 with (1) Charles King Company,
  Inc., (2) Ramona, Inc., and (3) Mike Prlich and Sons, Inc., respectively, for on-call
  emergency water and sewer repair services, extending the term of each contract
  by one year.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

8.  25-56058  Recommendation to receive and file the FY 2026 Business Plan, Part 1.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

9.  25-56059  Recommendation to receive and file the General Manager’s Monthly Report for
  July 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Utilities Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Board.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

CLOSED SESSION

25-56060  Pending Litigation – closed session conference with legal counsel relating to liability
  claims pursuant to subparagraph (2) of subdivision (d) of Section 54956.9 of the
  California Government Code: Government Tort Claim of Peter Fotinakes (CL25-0274).
